questions.question: How does David give thanks in Psalm 138?
options: With trembling fear, hiding his face from God's glory
With his whole heart, bowing toward God's holy temple
With bitter weeping, mourning over his many sins
With loud shouting, marching before the ark of God
questions.answer: With his whole heart, bowing toward God's holy temple

questions.question: What does David say the LORD does for the lowly?
options: He gathers the exiles, but the wicked he scatters abroad
He hears the humble, but the proud he turns aside
He feeds the hungry, but the rich he sends away empty
He regards the lowly, but the haughty he knows from afar
questions.answer: He regards the lowly, but the haughty he knows from afar

questions.question: David is confident the LORD will fulfill his purpose for him and not forsake the work of his hands.
